name: APU_2_User_Authorizations
title: APU.2 User Authorizations (Function)
description:
This category is about personal data collection and use, including access to device features, being understood and explicitly
 authorized (consented to) by the users of the app.

statement.label: APU.2#01
statement.requirement: The system SHALL use smartphone functionality and data sources only when essential to perform its specific functions. These include, but are not limited to, location services, camera, microphone, accelerometer and other sensors, contact lists, and calendars.

statement.label: APU.2#02
statement.requirement: The system SHALL ask the user for permission before using selected smartphone functions and data sources for the first time. The user can individually specify permissions for each function, data source, and user tracking activity controlled by the system.

statement.label: APU.2#03
statement.requirement: The system SHALL ask the user for permission to transmit data before exporting data from the smartphone or from any device integrated with the smartphone, explaining what data is being transmitted, to which recipients, and for what purposes, such as to the supplier's servers, for backups, or for large-scale data analysis. Permission is requested before the first potential transmission of data. Permission is requested again the first time any additional data elements are sent to an external data source where permission had previously been given for a smaller set of data. Permission is not requested at every transmission if the scope of exported data remains unchanged.

statement.label: APU.2#04
statement.requirement: IF the system sends PII, PHI, user-entered content, device data, or derived data to an external AI provider THEN the system SHALL obtain permission before the first transfer and clearly identify the recipient, purpose, data categories, retention approach, and whether the provider may use the data to train or improve a model.

statement.label: APU.2#05
statement.requirement: IF the system requests permission to use data it generated after that data is de-identified THEN the system SHALL inform the account holder who would have access to the de-identified data and for what purpose.

statement.label: APU.2#06
statement.requirement: IF the system requests permission to use data it generated after that data is de-identified THEN the system SHALL inform the account holder of the possibility that de-identified data can potentially be re-identified, and of the steps the sponsor takes to prevent re-identification.

statement.label: APU.2#07
statement.requirement: IF the user gives permission for data generated by the system to be de-identified and used THEN the system SHALL de-identify that data following, at minimum, realm-specific rules, such as HIPAA Safe Harbor in the USA.

statement.label: APU.2#08
statement.requirement: IF the system supports in-app payments THEN the system SHALL NOT trigger in-app payments in a way that can expose healthcare-related information to payment organizations.

statement.label: APU.2#09
statement.requirement: IF the system uses in-app advertising THEN the system SHALL disclose to the user the potential use of PHI or PII to personalize advertisements, and SHALL give the user the opportunity to consent or decline.

statement.label: APU.2#10
statement.requirement: IF the system requests to share data with social networks THEN the system SHALL provide the user with options to select which types of data will be shared, and SHALL inform the user of the potential consequences of the secondary use and sharing of that data outside the system's control. The system SHALL NOT commence data sharing with social networks until the user has consented.

statement.label: APU.2#11
statement.requirement: The system SHOULD permit a user to allow some, but not all, requested data to be exported from a smartphone or associated device, and SHOULD inform the user how limiting the data affects its functionality.

statement.label: APU.2#12
statement.requirement: IF a user denies a permission requested by the system THEN the system SHOULD inform the user of the consequence of not granting the permission and SHOULD give the user a further opportunity to grant it.

statement.label: APU.2#13
statement.requirement: IF the system uses AI functionality THEN the system SHALL provide a mechanism for a user to withdraw optional AI-related permissions and SHALL explain the effect of withdrawal on App functionality and on future AI data processing.

statement.label: APU.2#14
statement.requirement: IF the system offers more than one AI feature THEN the system MAY allow a user to make granular choices by AI feature, data type, or purpose, such as an AI coaching feature, document summarization, or model-improvement use.
